Expected durationSix (6) months, with possibility of renewal
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. To meet with greater demand for projects' implementation, the office of Rio de Janeiro is looking for an Administrative Assistant (Admin & Finance) that will be focusing on Brazil initiatives. The professional will be asked to assist the office team by contributing to the administrative and financial implementation of projects and initiatives. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Administrative Assistant (Admin & Finance) reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Administrative Assistant (Admin & Finance) will support the implementation of the projects in Brazil, with the following responsibilities: a. Support the administrative and financial implementation of projects and initiatives, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and procedures, under supervision. b. Assist in budget planning, monitoring, and revisions, including tracking expenditures against approved budgets. c. Under supervision, process and follow up on financial transactions, such as payments, advances, reimbursements, and vendor contracts. d. Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial and administrative records for projects and operations. e. Organize and archive all documents and information relevant to project administration. f. Support the team through audits and other administrative and financial compliance checks. g. Supporting the monitoring of financial reporting timelines and contribute to the preparation of financial reports for internal and external stakeholders. h. Liaise with programme teams, finance, and operations units to resolve administrative and financial issues under supervision. i. Support audits and financial reviews by ensuring availability and organization of required documentation. j. Write official letters in Portuguese. k. Assist with travel requests for the technical team, including travel requests and mission reports. l. Be responsible for keeping information organized and accessible. m. Participate in missions as requested. n. Carry out other activities requested by the Head of Office and/or Program Officer within the framework of this consultancy, without prejudice to fulfilling their responsibilities. m. Prepare reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. n. Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisor. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Administrative Assistant (Admin & Finance) shall support the Program Officers in the proper planning and management of programmes' implementation related to the office's project portfolio, according to the stated responsibilities. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation
Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Public Administration, Administration, Economics, or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience
A minimum of three (3) years of experience in program' implementation and projects in public administration or international organizations, admin and financial issues, and/or related areas is required.
Demonstrated experience in administrative and finance is required.
Work experience within the United Nations System is desirable.
International experience is desirable, particularly in the field of international cooperation for development, urban development, and project management. Skills
Good computer skills in Office Package (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) are required.
Mastery of technological tools and use of software and online platforms is required.
Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English and/or Spanish is desirable.

title: pessoa analista expansao sr
description:
AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE.

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA EXPANSAO SR NA YDUQS.

Temos um projeto grandioso e que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original, disruptiva, e com objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.

Venha fazer parte desse time

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Os principais desafios como PESSOA ANALISTA EXPANSAO SR são:

  • Desenvolver e manter modelos geoespaciais para identificação das melhores localizações para abertura de novas unidades, considerando variáveis demográficas, socioeconômicas, concorrência e potencial de mercado;
  • Conduzir análises territoriais por cidade/região, incluindo definição de áreas de influência (catchment área), mapas de calor, clusterização geográfica e estudos de densidade;
  • Integrar dados internos e externos (ex.: IBGE, bases públicas, dados de mercado, concorrência e performance histórica) para geração de indicadores de decisão;
  • Apoiar as áreas de expansão, franquias e estratégia com análises baseadas em location intelligence;
  • Estruturar critérios e score de priorização geográfica para expansão da rede;
  • Elaborar relatórios, dashboards e apresentações executivas com recomendações de localização;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com stakeholders internos, garantindo alinhamento entre dados, estratégia e decisão de negócio;
  • Documentar metodologias, premissas e modelos utilizados, assegurando reprodutibilidade e governança analítica.

Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos profissionais com:

  • Formação superior completa em áreas como Geografia, Estatística, Engenharia, Economia, Ciência de Dados, Sistemas de Informação ou correlatas;
  • Experiência profissional com geomarketing, geoprocessamento ou inteligência geográfica aplicada a negócios;
  • Conhecimento sólido em GIS (QGIS, ArcGIS, PostGIS ou equivalentes);
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados e análise estatística, preferencialmente utilizando Python ou R;
  • Vivência com análise territorial, potencial de mercado, expansão, varejo ou franquias;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e integrá-los a análises espaciais;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e/ou ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau ou similares);
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e com boa capacidade de comunicação com áreas de negócio.

Informações adicionais

Contamos com profissionais que valorizam a inovação em um ambiente diverso, com simplicidade e ética. Nossas iniciativas sempre têm o aluno no centro da decisão, pois consideramos o seu sucesso como nosso.

title: Mineral Strategy Analyst
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent, expat position.
Overview
We are seeking an experienced Transition Minerals Strategy Analyst to join Aramco Transition Minerals organization to lead our efforts in securing, managing, and optimizing the sustainable use of transition minerals critical to the global energy transition. These minerals, such as lithium, cobalt, nickel, and rare earth elements, are essential for renewable energy technologies, and other clean energy solutions. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in strategic planning, supply chain management, ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) principles, and policy advocacy. This role will also involve collaboration across industries, governments, and communities to address challenges and opportunities in the evolving transition minerals landscape.
About Aramco Transition Minerals (ATM)
Aramco Transition Minerals (ATM) is a new strategic initiative within Saudi Aramco's Upstream division, created to advance the exploration, extraction, and processing of key energy transition minerals—including lithium—to support the global shift toward sustainable energy solutions and contribute to the Kingdom's economic diversification goals.
Anchored in the ambitions of Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030, ATM is positioned to help establish the Kingdom as a leading global hub for critical minerals. The organization focuses on high‑value resources such as lithium, silicon, copper, nickel, graphite, and rare earth elements—materials essential to technologies like electric vehicles, renewable energy storage systems, and solar power generation.
As a newly formed and rapidly growing entity, ATM represents a significant opportunity to shape an emerging sector, drive technological innovation, and support the development of a resilient, future‑focused minerals supply chain.
Key Responsibilities
As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Lead the development of a comprehensive, long-term strategy for sourcing and utilizing transition minerals. This strategy should align with our organizational goals in sustainability, innovation, and growth.
Monitor and interpret global trends, including technological advancements, regulatory changes, and market dynamics, to identify opportunities and risks for the organization.
Establish a roadmap for securing critical mineral resources while prioritizing long-term sustainability and resilience.
Provide insights and recommendations on mineral financing strategies, investment opportunities, and risk management.
Collaborate with procurement and legal teams to establish long-term agreements with suppliers who meet sustainability criteria.
Act as a liaison between the company and key external stakeholders, including government agencies, potential investors and industry groups
Represent the company at international conferences, working groups, and forums focused on transition minerals, ensuring our leadership and reputation in the industry.
Develop and review financial models, feasibility studies, and cost-benefit analyses for mining and mineral projects.
Lead or support the evaluation, negotiation, and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with company goals and industry best practices
Develop mitigation strategies to address risks such as resource scarcity, geopolitical tensions, and supply disruptions.
Stay ahead of emerging technologies and trends that could redefine the transition minerals landscape.
Track and report on global mineral production, consumption patterns, and pricing trends to inform decision-making.
Continuously monitor and analyze industry data, reports, and market trends to provide actionable insights to the leadership team.
Develop comprehensive reports and presentations for executive leadership, detailing progress, risks, and recommendations.
Minimum Requirements
As a successful candidate you hold a:
A bachelor's degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Mining Geology, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred
Minimum of 7 years of experience in energy transition minerals (lithium, cobalt, nickel, or rare earth elements) development with a focus in strategy.
The ability to work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams, to communicate effectively and clearly with specialists in other cross-functional teams, and has excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Expertise in critical minerals such as lithium, cobalt, nickel, and rare earth elements, including their applications, extraction methods, and market dynamics
Strong understanding of mineralogy and metallurgical principles for transition minerals.
Knowledge of circular economy principles and recycling of transition minerals.
The ability to develop the business case strategically.
The ability to relocate to Saudi Arabia on a full-time basis.
Advanced English proficiency. CV's must be submitted in English.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Professor de Matemática
description:
Você tem uma mentalidade de crescimento e gostaria de fazer parte de um projeto inovador com impacto social?

Na Innovamat estamos buscando pessoas como você

Sobre nós

A Innovamat é uma empresa que desenvolve uma proposta educacional que tem como objetivo impulsionar a aprendizagem por competências, personalizada e profunda da matemática. Dirigida a crianças e jovens de 3 a 16 anos, prioriza a compreensão dos conteúdos e o desenvolvimento de habilidades matemáticas ligadas à resolução de problemas, fomentando a aprendizagem dessa disciplina através da experimentação, da conversação e da prática individualizada. Nesse sentido, a Innovamat oferece trajetórias de aprendizagem sequenciadas, recursos, formação e acompanhamento à comunidade educativa, com o apoio de especialistas em didática da matemática, a ciência da aprendizagem matemática.

Fundada em 2017 em Barcelona (e com uma equipe de 330 pessoas apaixonadas), a Innovamat colabora com docentes de mais de 2.400 centros educativos em 9 países (Espanha, Itália, México, Colômbia, Chile, Equador, Brasil, Peru e Estados Unidos) que ensinam matemática de forma competencial e significativa a mais de alunos.

  • Você fará parte da equipe de assessoria didática , atuando como ponto de contato no acompanhamento das escolas no Brasil.

  • Colaborará com a equipe de assessoria no desenvolvimento estratégico de parcerias já construídas.

  • Realizará ações formativas e de acompanhamento para escolas parceiras, como modelagens e observações de aula, encontros formativos, webinários, etc.

  • Começará a construir relacionamentos de longo prazo com professores e equipe de direção das diferentes escolas.

  • Trabalhará em um ambiente dinâmico para gerar um impacto significativo no mundo da educação em geral e nas salas de aula de matemática em particular.

  • Se reunirá com diferentes atores chave dentro de uma escola para apresentar a Innovamat: a proposta de aprendizagem de matemática por competências.

  • Impulsionará o processo de escolas parceiras com a Innovamat, desde renovações a expansões de parcerias.

O que buscamos em você?

  • Imprescindível experiência prévia como professor(a) e/ou coordenador(a) pedagógico(a), preferencialmente dos Anos Iniciais.

  • Paixão genuína pela matemática e pela educação (e por melhorar os métodos tradicionais).

  • Apaixonado por aprender e gerar impacto social. Queremos sentir a paixão

  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade.

  • Facilidade para falar em público e excelentes habilidades de comunicação.

  • Aprendizado rápido e autonomia.

  • Habilidade para conectar e gerenciar um portfólio de escolas parceiras.

  • Desejo de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, motivador e acelerado.

  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente, organizada e autodirigida.

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes com tensão e alta pressão.

  • Disponibilidade para viajar.

E se além disso…

  • Você tiver trabalhado em posições de desenvolvimento estratégico, no setor de educação ou em start-ups de alto crescimento ou consultorias estratégicas.

  • Tiver um mestrado ou especialização em Educação Matemática.

  • Tiver experiência com formação de professores.

  • Falar inglês e/ou espanhol

…será maravilhoso, embora não imprescindível

O que você pode esperar da Innovamat?

  • Um plano de desenvolvimento e crescimento pessoal e profissional em um ambiente jovem, entusiasta e dinâmico

  • Contato próximo e profundo com a Liderança da Innovamat no Brasil e América do Sul.

title: Atendente de loja
description:
O Atendente é o profissional responsável pelo atendimento pessoal ou telefônico garantindo o suporte necessário ao cliente ou público em geral. Um Atendente esclarece dúvidas ou faz registro de reclamações, visando oferecer aos seus clientes um excelente atendimento.

Está sob as responsabilidades de um Atendente realizar atendimento aos clientes, fazer captação de clientes, retenção de clientes, elaboração e analise de planilhas financeiras, fazer identificação de melhorias e em alguns casos realizar o atendimento até o fechamento e acompanhamento de uma venda.

  • Atender e recepcionar cliente na loja, pesquisando suas necessidades, orientando com todas as informações necessárias, organização por cor (setores), bijuterias em geral e decor. Com sua pesquisa sobre a necessidade do cliente, as possíveis combinações e formalidades do uso.
  • Conhecer e informar aos clientes as formas de pagamento aceita pela loja, clara e objetivamente.
  • Encaminhar cliente que não encontra o produto especifico no seu corredor para o vendedor próximo ao produto que o cliente deseja.
  • Realizar reservas de mercadoria para o cliente (no máximo 3 dias uteis, colocar em sacola lacrada, com o nome e o telefone do cliente e avisado o mesmo do prazo dado).
  • Receber mercadoria com o entregador (Motorista), conferindo romaneio item por item e se encontra etiquetas de código de barra aos produtos, assinando o romaneio quando estiver tudo identificado o que foi entregue. Obs: isso é feito pelo fiscal da loja, mas quando ele não estiver é reponsabilidade do vendedor.
  • Organizar e limpar slatwall (paredes com ganchos), gôndolas, armários, piso loja, armários loja, prateleira e piso estoque, conforme orientação do gerente, diariamente ou de acordo com a escala, visando e proporcionando conforto aos funcionários e ao conforto e praticidade ao cliente.
  • Participar efetivamente dos balanços de estoque e o salão loja, obedecendo às orientações e determinações da Gerente / Subgerente a fim de minimizar perca de mercadoria e para melhor execução do processo.
  • Participar de treinamentos e reuniões de desempenho quando solicitado pela Gerente / Subgerente ou Diretoria da empresa.
  • Conhecer e saber Opera o Sistema de caixa e também operar a máquina de cartão, visando efetivar a venda no caso de qualquer imprevisto com o Operador de caixa.
  • Resolver com auxílio o Gerente / Subgerente os problemas referentes a troca de mercadoria com defeito ou usadas, fora dos padrões normais de troca, recebendo a peça com problema.

title: Partnership Manager
description:
Company Description

At INSIDEA, we are a fully remote organization, hiring top talents from across the globe to deliver exceptional digital marketing and HubSpot solutions. Our diverse services are designed to enhance your brand's online presence and drive real, measurable growth. From marketing optimization and content creation to full-scale HubSpot integration, we provide a holistic approach to transform your digital experience and maximize performance.

Job Description

We're looking for a Partnership Manager (B2B) to help us grow, manage, and maximize the impact of our strategic alliances with key SaaS platforms like Mailchimp, Salesforce, Pipedrive, and others. This is a hands-on role ideal for someone with prior partnerships or tech alliance experience who enjoys both strategy and execution.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Platform Engagement: Represent INSIDEA in partner meetings, demonstrating credibility and aligning on shared goals with platforms like Mailchimp, Salesforce, Pipedrive, and others.
  • Opportunity Identification: Analyze each partner ecosystem to identify collaboration opportunities that drive growth for both sides.
  • GTM Strategy: Work cross-functionally to design and execute go-to-market (GTM) plans for each partner relationship.
  • Technical Understanding: Build a deep understanding of partner products and APIs to identify integration, co-marketing, or co-selling opportunities.
  • Internal Alignment: Coordinate across Sales, Marketing, and Delivery teams to ensure successful execution of partnership initiatives.
  • Tracking & Reporting: Monitor partnership performance and provide regular updates and insights to internal stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, or tech alliances within the SaaS space.
  • Proven track record managing external partner relationships, preferably with platform partners like Salesforce, HubSpot, Mailchimp, or similar.
  • Strong communication skills—comfortable presenting, negotiating, and representing INSIDEA in strategic conversations.
  • A technically fluent mindset—you don't need to code, but you should grasp APIs, integrations, and how SaaS products work under the hood.
  • Self-starter attitude with a bias for action, problem-solving, and execution.
  • Familiarity with channel/partner marketing strategies.

Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.

A Zerezes vive um momento de forte expansão e amadurecimento e para isso estamos montando nosso novo time de Produtos Digitais com a missão de transformar a experiência do online ao físico. title: Business Operations Associate
description:
Company Description
Evergreen Permits specializes in helping homeowners, contractors, and developers in Seattle simplify the permitting process for small residential remodeling projects. With a team of experienced architects and designers, we ensure compliance with local building codes while saving our clients time and effort. Our services include creating as-built drawings, architectural drafting, detailed documentation, and managing seamless permit submissions. Our mission is to take the hassle out of the paperwork, making remodel projects straightforward and stress-free for our clients.
We're a small (but growing) architectural permit services company building a smarter, faster way to serve contractors and other blue-collar builders—an audience that's been overlooked for way too long.
This role is for someone who thrives on building structure from scratch: systems, workflows, SOPs, and the day-to-day operations that keep everything moving. Early on, you'll wear multiple hats. Over time, the systems you help create will become standalone roles as we scale.
What you'll own (initially)
Answering phone calls and returning missed calls
Sales calls (not pushy sales calls, just explaining what we do)
CRM implementation + management (pipeline hygiene, automations, reporting)
Screening web submissions and routing qualified leads to the sales team
Coordinating with marketing team
Building systems and SOPs across the company so we can train future hires fast
Meeting regularly with the owner to plan, build, and improve these systems together
Who we're looking for:
Excellent spoken English. You will be talking to potential customers very often and communication is key for this role
Ability to work during Seattle business hours - 8am-5pm PST / 1pm-10pm GMT-3
You are self-motivated and autonomous—you don't need constant direction
You like creating order: checklists, templates, systems, and repeatable processes
You're comfortable using modern tools such as: CRM (Hubspot or similar), Monday, Microsoft Suite, Excel, Word, automation tools like Zapier, understanding project boards & scheduling tools.
You're a kind person. We're a curated group of highly motivated people that respect and show kindness to others. We want to learn from you and visa-versa
You're excited about using AI thoughtfully to move faster and work smarter
You communicate clearly, follow through, and keep things organized
Bonus if you've supported a founder, managed operations, or helped implement a CRM before
Why this role is different
You'll be building the operational foundation of a company with real momentum—helping turn a messy early stage into a machine we can scale.
Qualifications
Strong Administrative Assistance and Clerical Skills
Exceptional Phone Etiquette and Communication Skills
Experience in Executive Administrative Assistance
Proficiency in using office software and organizational tools
Ability to work independently in a remote environment
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred
Prior experience in a permitting, architecture, or construction-related field is a plus
Benefits
Remote contractor role with autonomy to manage your day while collaborating closely with our US team.
Pay: between R$ 3,200 – R$ 4,000 depending on experience
Competitive starting pay depending on experience.
Two weeks of paid time off per year plus eight paid US holidays (you may swap any holiday for one you observe) and one week off in December for a total of around 1 month PTO.
Ongoing mentoring by the owner, process improvement, and client management.
Clear career path—grow into senior role starting on the ground floor of an exciting one of a kind company
We're an early-stage company fulfilling a clear demand in the building and construction industry, so joining us now means getting in on the ground floor with plenty of room to move up as we scale.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Operações
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Comprador de Importação
description:
Nossa missão é cuidar e proteger você e seu lar. Somos movidos pela paixão de entregar excelência aos nossos clientes e consumidores, por meio de marcas relevantes e produtos eficientes. Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e dinâmico, onde cada talento é reconhecido e incentivado a crescer.

Aqui, acreditamos no poder da inovação e no espírito empreendedor, cultivando um time determinado a conquistar a preferência de quem confia em nossos produtos. Somos guiados por valores sólidos, como foco no cliente, iniciativa, colaboração e o respeito com os recursos da empresa.

Se você busca um lugar onde sua criatividade é valorizada, suas ideias têm impacto e o crescimento profissional é uma realidade, a Limppano é o lugar certo para você. Venha transformar o futuro conosco e fazer parte de uma história que cuida, protege e faz a diferença.

Junte-se à nossa equipe e construa uma carreira com propósito

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Planejar, coordenar e acompanhar processos de importação de matérias-primas, insumos e/ou equipamentos;
  • Emitir e conferir documentos relacionados à importação (Invoice, Packing List, BL, AWB, DI, etc.);
  • Realizar cotações e negociações com fornecedores internacionais, agentes de carga e despachantes aduaneiros;
  • Controlar e acompanhar pedidos de compra internacional, garantindo prazos e custos;
  • Acompanhar processos de desembaraço aduaneiro e garantir o correto enquadramento fiscal e tributário;
  • Atualizar e controlar indicadores (lead time, custos de importação, etc.).
  • Apoiar na análise e melhoria de processos logísticos internacionais.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre legislação aduaneira, tratados internacionais e normas da Receita Federal/SISCOMEX.
  • Negociar as melhores condições de compras, contratos, produtos e serviços em termos de custo, qualidade e atendimento, através da elaboração da estratégia de compras junto aos fornecedores;
  • Desenvolver alternativas de fornecimento qualificada com o apoio e alinhamento com o cliente interno;
  • Entender as necessidades e prioridades dos clientes internos;
  • Parametrizar os dados do fluxo de produção para análise de giro, acompanhar os dados do sistema, verificar os níveis de estoque para acompanhar os prazos de entrega podendo agilizá-los ou prorrogá-los junto aos fornecedores em função das necessidades e fluxo da produção;
  • Preparar relatórios com mapas e quadros demonstrativos sobre o desempenho e performance do de todas as atividades do departamento de compras e fornecedores para apreciação e controle do superior;
  • Elaborar relatório com cotações mensais das principais matérias primas importadas.

Requisitos e qualificações

Para você fazer parte do nosso Grupo de talentos, você precisa ter:

  • Graduação completa em Comércio Exterior, Relações Internacionais, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com operações de importação (preferencialmente em ambiente industrial);
  • Conhecimento de Incoterms, SISCOMEX, DUIMP e demais ferramentas da área;
  • Excel intermediário/avançado;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado (leitura e escrita técnica);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Botafogo de forma presencial;
  • Atitude Inovadora;
  • Senso de dono;
  • Gostar de superar desafios;
  • Trabalhar com metas;
  • Ser polivalente.

Diferenciais:

  • Vivência com ERP SANKHYA;
  • Conhecimento em regimes especiais (Ex-Tarifário e Drawback);
  • Espanhol será considerado um plus.

Informações adicionais

Além de um ambiente desenvolvedor, oferecemos ao nosso time:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;

  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com faculdades;
  • Convênio com farmácias;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Welhub;
  • Descontos nos nossos produtos em nossa loja online.

SOBRE A LIMPPANO


Companhia nacional com mais de 60 anos de atuação, a Limppano é referência em limpeza seca, químicos e perfumação para o lar. Com um complexo industrial próprio no Rio de Janeiro, a empresa apresenta um portfólio completo de produtos com alta performance distribuídos em todo o país e na América Latina, nas principais redes do varejo supermercadista e de atacado, o que registra resultados consistentes e crescimento na indústria de limpeza.

title: Graphic Designer BRA
description:
A Graphic Designer is responsible for creating compelling visual content that communicates a brand's message effectively, captures attention, and engages its target audience. This role requires a blend of creative vision, design expertise, and technical proficiency to produce high-quality visuals across multiple platforms and formats.
Graphic Designers work on a variety of projects, including digital and print media—such as social media graphics, website layouts, online advertisements, email templates, presentations, infographics, packaging, brochures, and event materials. They are skilled at translating complex ideas into clear, aesthetically pleasing designs that align with the company's brand identity, tone, and visual guidelines.
Key responsibilities include collaborating with marketing teams, copywriters, and other stakeholders to conceptualize and execute design projects, selecting appropriate color schemes, typography, imagery, and layouts that resonate with the intended audience. They must also adapt designs for different formats and devices, ensuring visual consistency and usability across various channels.
Proficiency in industry-standard design software—such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma, or Canva—is essential. A strong understanding of design principles, user experience (UX), and current design trends enables Graphic Designers to produce innovative and effective visuals.
Beyond design creation, Graphic Designers may be involved in maintaining brand asset libraries, preparing files for print or digital publication, and ensuring compliance with production specifications. They also review feedback, make revisions, and manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
To excel in this role, a Graphic Designer needs exceptional attention to detail, creativity, time management, and communication skills, as well as the ability to balance artistic innovation with practical business objectives.

Sobre o CNA Idiomas

O CNA Idiomas é uma rede de ensino de inglês e espanhol com uma trajetória de mais de 50 anos no mercado, e é parte do grupo educacional CNA+, atendendo cerca de 400 mil alunos anualmente em mais de 730 unidades em todo o território brasileiro. É uma das marcas mais premiadas do franchising nacional. Em um universo com mais de 3 mil marcas, o CNA Idiomas é a única rede a obter, por 32 vezes consecutivas, o Selo de Excelência, concedido pela Associação Brasileira de Franchising (ABF), que em 2020 também escolheu o CNA Idiomas como Franqueador do Ano. Além disso, a marca conquistou o Prêmio Top Educação em 2023, consolidando ainda mais sua posição de destaque. O CNA Idiomas também figura na lista de Melhores Franquias do Brasil, com Selo 5 Estrelas concedido pela revista Pequenas Empresas & Grandes Negócios (PEGN), e no Top 25 do Franchising do Grupo Bittencourt.

Sobre a Ctrl+Play

A Ctrl+Play é uma rede de franquias de tecnologia e inovação que oferece cursos de robótica e programação para o público a partir de 7 anos. Com metodologias de ensino exclusivas e recursos tecnológicos avançados, os alunos podem desenvolver habilidades em programação, robótica, criação de jogos, modelagem 3D e aprender conceitos de lógica de forma dinâmica, divertida e envolvente, proporciona uma experiência de aprendizado estimulante e enriquecedora. A escola faz parte do grupo CNA+ desde novembro de 2023 e, atualmente, conta com mais de 90 unidades em operação. A Ctrl+Play também é uma das marcas franqueadoras integrantes da Associação Brasileira do Franchising (ABF).

Sobre o grupo educacional CNA+

Grupo educacional com mais de 900 franquias localizadas em todos os estados do Brasil, o CNA+ é composto pelas marcas CNA Idiomas e Ctrl+Play. A franquia de ensino de idiomas (cursos de inglês e espanhol) tem mais de 50 anos de atuação no mercado e cerca de 400 mil alunos/ano em mais de 730 unidades, sendo uma das marcas mais premiadas do franchising nacional. Já a Ctrl+Play, franquia de tecnologia e inovação, oferece cursos de robótica e programação para o público a partir de 7 anos. Faz parte do grupo CNA+ desde novembro de 2023 e, atualmente, conta com mais de 90 unidades em operação.

title: HSE Specialist
description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron's 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Your responsibilities:

  • Contribute to improving Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) performance and Corporate Responsibility in assigned geography. Support the business by applying in-depth knowledge to offer solutions and advice through delivery of Group-wide performance improvement programs and/or Group Audit Program.

  • Governance: Delivers and deploys HSE training, audit and Group-wide performance improvement programs to the Divisions and Local Business Units.

  • Metrics: Provides analysis of HSE data within area of responsibility. Reports on progress on implementation of Sustainability Objectives and key performance indicators (KPI) as required.

  • Regulatory Compliance: Contributes to assessing emerging trends and legislation in HSE and communicates relevant information on legal requirements within area of expertise and geography. Supports constituent countries to operate in compliance with standards and respective legal obligations.

  • Risk Management: Delivers audit (as per Group Audit Program) and supports follow up of improvement actions in the Local Business Units.

  • Communication & Engagement: Cooperates across functions and with business partners to raise awareness and drive performance, engages with internal and external stakeholders to build commitment and credibility for the COE.

  • Operational Support: Contributes to driving behavioral change and continuous improvement though delivery of training and competence initiatives and expert support to the Local Business Units in line with yearly HSE plan agreed with the Business Units. Supports the sharing of best practice. Coordinates reporting on HSE performance and support delivery of Group audit program.

  • Project Management: Contributes to and/or plans and executes Health, Safety and Environment performance and Corporate Responsibility related projects. Develops and reports on project objectives. Manages project resources such as manpower, financials and other relevant factors.

Your background:

  • +5 yrs relevant OHS/HSE practical experience, with preference within an international company

  • National/international certificate/diploma in HSE/OHS

  • Good communicator with ability to adjust communication to different levels of the organization

  • ISO 45001, 14001 knowledge / internal auditor certification

title: Operations Manager BRA
description:
An Operations Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring that a team's day-to-day activities run smoothly and align with the organization's strategic objectives. This position is responsible for overseeing operational processes, ensuring that resources—such as personnel, budgets, equipment, and time—are used as efficiently and effectively as possible. By setting and maintaining high company standards, an Operations Manager works to consistently exceed objectives, improve productivity, and foster a culture of excellence.
The role often requires coordinating between frontline employees and senior leadership, serving as a critical link to ensure that communication flows clearly in both directions. This includes translating high-level business goals into practical, actionable plans for teams, as well as escalating operational challenges to upper management when needed.
Typical duties may involve developing and optimizing workflows, managing budgets, monitoring performance metrics, and implementing process improvements to boost efficiency and quality. An Operations Manager also plays an active role in problem-solving, anticipating risks, and addressing issues before they escalate, ensuring smooth operations even under tight deadlines or high-pressure situations.
In addition, this role often includes training, mentoring, and performance evaluation to help employees prioritize tasks, meet individual and team goals, and contribute to a positive, high-performance workplace culture. Success as an Operations Manager requires a balance of strategic thinking, strong leadership, adaptability, and excellent organizational skills, along with the ability to make data-driven decisions that drive sustainable growth and operational excellence.
By applying to this position, we'll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match.

title: Social Media Manager BRA
description:
A Social Media Manager is responsible for building, managing, and expanding a company's presence across multiple social media platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), TikTok, and emerging channels. This role goes beyond simply posting content—it involves crafting a cohesive brand voice, designing and executing data-driven content strategies, and ensuring consistent messaging across all touchpoints.
Daily responsibilities often include planning editorial calendars, creating engaging text, image, and video content, scheduling and publishing posts, and actively interacting with followers to foster an engaged online community. A Social Media Manager also monitors industry trends, platform algorithm changes, and competitor activity to adapt strategies proactively.
Equally important is performance analysis—tracking metrics such as reach, engagement, click-through rates, and conversions to assess campaign effectiveness and inform future decisions. This requires proficiency with analytics tools, an understanding of paid advertising, and the ability to translate data insights into actionable improvements.
Success in this position demands strong communication skills, creativity, adaptability, and a deep understanding of digital marketing principles. A great Social Media Manager not only amplifies brand awareness but also drives audience loyalty and contributes directly to achieving broader business goals.
By applying to this position, we'll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match.

title: SDR (Sales Development Representative) BRA (Remote)
description:
A Sales Development Representative (SDR) plays a critical role in driving revenue growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers for the company's products or services. As the first point of contact in the sales process, SDRs are responsible for creating a strong pipeline of opportunities that fuels the success of the sales team.
This role involves researching and segmenting target markets, identifying decision-makers within organizations, and using multiple outreach channels—such as cold calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn messaging, and social media engagement—to connect with prospects. SDRs must understand each prospect's industry, challenges, and goals to effectively tailor their pitch and communicate the value proposition of the company's offerings.
Beyond initiating contact, SDRs qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring that account executives receive prospects who are ready and able to engage in meaningful sales conversations. They also schedule discovery calls, product demos, or meetings, and document all interactions in the company's CRM system to maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline.
An effective SDR is goal-driven, resilient, and curious, able to handle rejection while staying motivated to meet or exceed key performance metrics such as outreach volume, response rates, and conversion rates. Collaboration with the marketing team is also essential, as SDRs often provide feedback on campaign performance and prospect insights to improve lead generation efforts.
Success in this role requires exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, strong active listening abilities, and the capacity to quickly learn and articulate the benefits of complex products or services. SDRs who excel not only open doors for new business but also build lasting relationships that can lead to long-term customers and sustainable company growth.

title: Senior Operations Geologist
description:
* Please ensure attached resume is in English language *
The Operations Geologist ensures all wells are drilled safely, stays in sync with all regulations, and efficiently to meet defined well objectives in accordance with the Statement of Requirements (SOR) and meets all expectations of the New Wells Common Process. This delivery requires collaboration and effective communication across bp Subsurface and Wells teams. A strong HSSE attitude and commercial awareness are essential, with a focus on safe, efficient, and cost-effective practices.
Essential Experience And Job Requirements
Degree in Geology, Geophysics or Geoscience or related field
Seasoned professional of relevant industry experience, most of which should have been gained in a geological operations environment
Industry experience in the areas of well planning and operations geology, well-site geology. Working knowledge of drilling operations, pore pressure, mudlogging is desirable
Experience with formation evaluation tools (LWD/MWD, wireline logging) and basic interpretation of rock/fluid types and borehole conditions
Proficiency in monitoring drilling progress and interpreting real-time geological data.
Ability to coordinate mobilization of geological contractors and service providers.
Proficiency with geological reporting and data management tools, with experience integrating digital solutions into workflows.
Geological, seismic and petrophysical log interpretation using workstation skills is beneficial;
Strong written and verbal communication skills
The individual needs to have a collaborative team-first mentality, be self-motivated, with a strong ability to integrate across subject areas
Ability to lead the subsurface efforts in late design (D5-11) activities consistent with bp well planning process, leading the creation of the GOP prior to drilling, and the EOWR (End of Well Report) and required handover documents following TD.
In addition, it would be help if you had
Experience with Offshore Brazil exploration and development wells
Well Planning & Design
HSSE focus and ability to influence compliance standards for Safety and Operational Risks
Support well planning activities and construction of relevant NWS documents consistent with bp's Wells Common Process, WCD-SOR (Wells Concept Document, Statement of Requirements) D1-D8 Stage gates ( All process decision points are numbered D1-D11)
Assist in the creation of pre-drill risk registers and ensure mitigation and contingency plans are created for all geological risks
Ensure integration of well planning and operational activity through strong collaboration with key interested parties, NWS (New Wells Solutions) and Wells leadership
Liaise with project geologists and well engineers to define well functional specifications and casing points while defining operational success criteria and support scenario planning
Lead the construction of the GOP (Geological Operations Plan) ensuring all relevant information is contained in this document
Geological Operations
Lead the daily subsurface operations meeting with the Rig based subsurface entities (WSG, BioStrat, ML, LWD), present NDS (No Drilling Surprises), expected geology in subsurface hole section previews, and reviews
Participate in DWOP, LWOP, CWOP exercises, ensure that the speciality vendors are engaged early in the process, present material on NDS, expected geology for subsurface hole section previews, hole section reviews for the well.
Monitor real-time well data and perform geologic correlations; work closely with petrophysicists on LWD and wireline data, coring operations, and data transmission
Supervise and coordinate with the Wellsite Geologist, ensuring alignment on subsurface objectives, data quality, operational decisions and that all geological activities on the rig are properly managed.
Provide support to the wellsite geologist: daily and as needed ops call, provide up to date information and offset date, collaborate between Subsurface and Wells to ensure all well objectives are delivered safely.
Ensure efficient delivery of the data acquisition program, ensure Vendors Co-owners are delivering and receiving all required data and updates. SPA for Co-Owner communication and information dissemination.
Post Well
Support successful EOW Report completion ensuring the report meets the expectations of the New Wells Common Process
Ensure all data is finalised and electronically captures in the corporate regional data store and hard data copy is distributed accordingly to partners
Capture and document all post well key takeaways and share in appropriate NWD venues.
Support root cause analysis for any NPT event related to subsurface operations (Orange category) and ensure these findings are distributed through the appropriate venues and collaborators

At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and high-reaching environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.

title: Junior Maintenance Technician
description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron's 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Your responsibilities:

  • In this position, the Service Technician will be responsible for carrying out service and maintenance tasks on turbochargers, working both at company facilities and at customer sites. In this role you will be responsible for performing service and maintenance on Turbochargers in Brazil.

  • The role provides specialized technical support, executing activities in accordance with Accelleron workflows, quality standards, and safety guidelines — ensuring superior customer experience and operational excellence.

  • Service Delivery: Performs Service tasks like disassembly, cleaning, inspection, measurement and assembly of different types of turbochargers, in accordance with work instructions, through the identification of technical problems, carrying out remote and in-person analyses at the Workshop and or in the field in various categories of vessels (ships, platforms, etc.) and thermoelectric plants. In the field it means by performing installation and commissioning, maintenance, repairs, updates, renovations and replacements, among others, meeting customer expectations and pre-established internal procedures.

  • Customer Approach: Contributes to customer satisfaction by executing Service work according to customer order and expectation Creates and maintains a good relationship with customers and understands their needs Identifies new sales opportunities and communicates them internally. Execute the repair according to instructions from service coordination

  • Materials & Supply: Coordinates, prepares and ensures that all materials, parts and equipment are available and at the appropriate quality for Service activities.

  • Documents & Reports: Prepares all documents and reports to be signed by the customer representative Reports work done in a timely manner and follows up when needed. Perform maintenance inspections and reports on turbochargers. Clean up parts and take pictures and measurements as requested by maintenance tool and process

  • Troubleshooting: Proactively identifies potential equipment failures and requests proactive corrective actions Troubleshoots equipment failure and makes recommendations to avoid repeating the problem in the future.

  • Operational Excellence Proactively identifies suggestions for product and quality improvement and communicates them further in the Accelleron organization Provides recommendations to management to improve operations and customer service.

  • Health, Safety, Environmental, Quality and Integrity: Applies safety rules and safe practices, environmental responsibilities as well as quality process. Reports unsafe practices and incidents.

Your background:

Education and Experience -

  • Technical training in Mechanics with an active CFT (Mechanical Technician Certificate);

  • Experience in maintenance and service of rotating machinery, engines (minimum 2 years), or preferable focus on working with turbochargers, large combustion engines, and/or mechanical technologies related to the maritime segment;

  • Preferable experience in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including the use of precision measuring instruments, hand tools, hydraulic and pneumatic tools, etc;

  • Preferably certified or experienced in lifting operations, overhead crane handling, and electric forklift, work at height, ensuring compliance with industrial safety standards;

  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, Planner etc.);

  • Intermediate English;

  • Availability for national and international travel to execute services and training;

  • Active driver's license

  • Passport.

Core Competencies -

  • Familiarity in working within regulations and rules, following management guidelines;

  • Service and solution-oriented mindset, with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills;

  • Customer and results orientation

  • Responsibility, autonomy, and commitment to safety

  • Effective communication and teamwork.

  • Proven capability to perform well under emergency work demand.

  • Proactivity and continuous improvement mindset.

Job Conditions -

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

  • Modality: Workshop and Field (customer site) activities. Weekly adapted based on the customer's demand

  • Flexibility to work outside of normal business hours

  • Available to travel: Required across Brazil neighboring countries (Uruguay, Paraguay, Bolivia, Chile, Peru, Argentina)

  • Report to: Workshop Manager.

Your benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package

  • International development opportunities

  • Pharmacy Allowance

  • Credit Union

  • Global Fitness Platform (Wellhub).

  • Profit Sharing

  • Private Pension Plan

  • Health Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • Life Insurance

  • Transport Voucher

  • Food Voucher

  • Employee Assistance program.

description:
O Grupo Transfero é uma empresa internacional com sede em Zug, Suíça, no coração do Crypto Valley. Nosso propósito é facilitar e promover o acesso e a adoção de ativos digitais, viabilizando uma transição segura para um sistema financeiro global mais descentralizado e fundamentado na liberdade e autonomia.

Oferecemos soluções privadas baseadas na tecnologia blockchain. Acreditamos na ruptura dos mercados tradicionais e, assim, atendemos clientes que desejam ter acesso a essa nova classe de ativos, proporcionando uma experiência exclusiva para nossos clientes individuais e institucionais.

Requisitos do prestador de serviços:

  • Sólida experiência no desenvolvimento de interfaces em  (preferencialmente com  e TypeScript).

Diferenciais:

● Realizar registro fotográfico e comunicar à governança.

● Acondicionar em saco identificado com o número do apartamento;

● Entregar à governanta ou à lavanderia, conforme orientação.

○ Secador de cabelo;

○ Cafeteira;

○ Sanduicheira;

○ Liquidificador;

○ Ferro de passar, entre outros.

7. Ar-condicionado e ventiladores

● Testar, higienizar e registrar por foto o ar-condicionado e o ventilador de teto.

8. Registro fotográfico

● Realizar fotos do antes e depois da limpeza dos apartamentos.

● Encaminhar todos os registros à governanta ou ao canal definido pela gerência.

9. Qualidade e padrão de serviço

● Executar as atividades com zelo, atenção aos detalhes e foco na qualidade.

● Garantir que os ambientes estejam prontos para uso, conforme os padrões da organização.

10. Comunicação de irregularidades

● Reportar imediatamente à governança  qualquer irregularidade, assegurando a resolução antes da entrada do hóspede.

title: Network Solution Architect
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own  aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.
Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1Global, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.
We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.
Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.
Key Responsibilities

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer-centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non-functional and functional state-of-the-art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement
Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud-based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big-picture goals inform technical details and vice-versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi-cultural/multi-country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Esta pessoa irá atuar no atendimento, realizando a coleta de materiais biológicos para a marca LAFE. O nosso foco está na excelência do atendimento e segurança nos procedimentos dos pacientes.

Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

  7. Analisar impacto na implementação dos projetos de engenharia nas rotinas operacionais das plantas de produção de petróleo, no tocante a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  8. Participar de todas as etapas de projetos de engenharia desde a concepção da solução, projeto básico, projeto de detalhamento, implementação e AS-BUILT no tocante a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  9. Coordenar ou auxiliar na coordenação de todas as etapas dos projetos de engenharia uni ou multidisciplinares garantindo os prazos, qualidade e exequibilidade dos projetos;

  11. Emitir pareceres definindo as prioridades, prazos, planejamento e alocação de recursos dos projetos, no tocante a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  12. Efetuar e emitir relatórios de visitas técnicas a fornecedores, contratadas, parceiros e unidades de produção de petróleo quando solicitado, no tocante a atuação da disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica;

  14. Emitir, Aprovar e Verificar documentos técnicos de engenharia aplicáveis a etapa de comissionamento de projetos, no tocante a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  15. Acompanhar e prestar apoio técnico no escritório, no site de fornecedores e nas áreas operacionais durante as etapas de implementação e comissionamento de projetos, no tocante a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  16. Apoiar tecnicamente os setores de suprimentos e de suas contratadas, na prospecção de fornecedores, seleção, especificação e pareceres técnicos de materiais/equipamentos no tocante a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  17. Atuar na prospecção de novos fornecedores, novos equipamentos e novas tecnologias aplicáveis a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  18. Planejar tanto a gestão quanto a execução do comissionamento, com envolvimento de todas as áreas que tenham interface com a atividade (Operação, Contratadas, Manutenção, SMS e outras), sendo necessário para isso definir e detalhar os elementos técnicos principais, a linha de base do cronograma, a organização e os meios para a execução do processo de comissionamento;
  19. Disponibilizar toda documentação referente a recebimento, montagem e condicionamento e dos meios físicos necessários para a execução da fase seguinte do comissionamento (Pré-operação e Partida);
  20. Identificar os equipamentos sujeitos à Testes de Aceitação em Fábrica (TAF), suas condições de acompanhamento e colaboradores responsáveis pelo acompanhamento dos respectivos testes;
  21. Acompanhar montagem, limpeza, inspeção e instalação de equipamentos e instrumentos;
  22. Comprovação do atendimento às normas regulamentadoras;
  23. Identificação e registro de pendências não impeditivas;
  24. Aplicação de Listas de Verificação (LVs) ou Folhas de Verificação de Itens (FVIs);
  25. Promover permanentemente a análise dos projetos de modo a proporcionar um grau de facilidade de construção.

title: Sales Operations Assistant
description:
Who Are We?

Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just three years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 140 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.

Our Impact

While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 4,000 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don't just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.

Our Vision

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

Are You Ready?

This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let's explore this journey together.


Check us out here: Decentralized Masters

What will you be doing?

We're hiring a Sales Operations Assistant to execute and maintain the operational foundation of our sales systems inside HubSpot.

You will work inside the CRM daily to ensure data accuracy, lead routing integrity, workflow reliability, and pipeline hygiene.

This is a highly detail-oriented execution role. You will not design revenue strategy — you will ensure it runs flawlessly.

Key ResponsibilitiesCRM & Pipeline Integrity
  • Maintain accurate deal stages, ownership, and required properties
  • Ensure every active deal has a defined next step
  • Identify and merge duplicate records
  • Audit pipelines for stale or mis-staged deals
HubSpot Execution
  • Maintain workflows and automation under Specialist direction
  • Manage sequences and enrollment logic
  • Maintain lists and segmentation accuracy
  • Validate lead routing rules
  • QA workflow triggers and task creation
  • Update properties and lifecycle stages
Lead Flow & SLA Monitoring
  • Ensure new leads are assigned within defined SLA
  • Flag unworked or unreachable leads
  • Monitor speed-to-lead and follow-up consistency
  • Escalate anomalies immediately
Reporting & KPI Support
  • Maintain daily and weekly KPI sheets
  • Validate CRM data feeding dashboards
  • Flag anomalies in DPL, show rate, and pipeline movement
What Great Looks Like
  • Zero unassigned leads
  • <1% duplicate rate
  • <2% missing required deal properties
  • No silent workflow failures
  • Accurate reporting delivered on time
What do you bring?
  • 2–4+ years in Sales Ops, CRM administration, or sales support
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience (required)
  • Experience working with workflows, sequences, and segmentation
  • Strong process discipline and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote-first culture with a globally distributed team.
  • Opportunity to own the organic growth engine of a fast-scaling DeFi brand.
  • Access to cutting-edge tools, data, and creative freedom to innovate.
  • A values-driven company culture that rewards results, autonomy, and excellence.
This Role Is Ideal For

Someone who:

  • Loves systems and clean data
  • Notices errors others miss
  • Prefers operational precision over sales strategy
  • Wants to grow into a Sales Ops Specialist role

If you are ready to take on a challenge that will shape the future of crypto finance and grow with a team of innovators, we want to hear from you
